/-- Θ-equivalence is symmetric. -/
theorem isTheta_eq_isTheta' : IsTheta (fun n => (n : ℝ) / Real.log n) (fun n => (f n - 2 * n : ℕ) : ℕ → ℝ) Filter.atTop := by
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (f n - 2 * n : ℕ)
  let g : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (n : ℝ) / Real.log n
  have h₁ : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 < g n := by
    intro n hn
    have h₁ : (10 : ℕ) ≤ n := Filter.tendsto_atTop_iff.mpr ⟨10, fun k hk => by
      by_cases hk' : k < 10; simp_all [Nat.le_of_lt_succ, Nat.le_of_lt_succ]
      <;> linarith⟩ hn
    have h₂ : (10 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h₁
    have h₃ : (10 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by linarith
    have h₄ : 0 < Real.log (n : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have h₅ : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by linarith
    exact div_pos h₅ h₄
  have h₂ : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 ≤ g n := by
    intro n hn
    have h₁ : (10 : ℕ) ≤ n := Filter.tendsto_atTop_iff.mpr ⟨10, fun k hk => by
      by_cases hk' : k < 10; simp_all [Nat.le_of_lt_succ, Nat.le_of_lt_succ]
      <;> linarith⟩ hn
    have h₂ : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le n
    have h₃ : 0 < Real.log (n : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by
      have h₄ : (1 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by
        have h₅ : (1 : ℕ) < n := by
          have h₆ : (10 : ℕ) ≤ n := h₁
          omega
        exact_mod_cast h₅
      exact h₄)
    linarith
  have h₃ : ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 0 ≤ f n := by
    intro n hn
    have h₁ : (2 : ℕ) ≤ n := by
      have h₂ : (10 : ℕ) ≤ n := Filter.tendsto_atTop_iff.mpr ⟨10, fun k hk => by
        by_cases hk' : k < 10; simp_all [Nat.le_of_lt_succ, Nat.le_of_lt_succ]
        <;> linarith⟩ hn
      omega
    have h₂ : (2 : ℕ) ≤ f n := by
      have h₃ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ n ! := Nat.factorial_pos n
      have h₄ : (2 : ℕ) ≤ f n := by
        classical
        have h₅ : ∃ (m : ℕ), m ∈ {m : ℕ | ∃ (k : ℕ), ∃ (f : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono f ∧ n < f 0 ∧ f (k - 1) = m ∧ ∏ i < k, f i = n !} := by
          have h₆ : ∃ (m : ℕ), m ∈ {m : ℕ | ∃ (k : ℕ), ∃ (f : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono f ∧ n < f 0 ∧ f (k - 1) = m ∧ ∏ i < k, f i = n !} := by
            by_cases h : n ≤ 1
            · have h₁ : n = 0 ∨ n = 1 := by
                cases n <;> simp_all
              cases h₁ <;> simp_all [Nat.factorial]
              <;> use 1
              <;> use 1
              <;> use fun _ => 1
              <;> simp_all
              <;> aesop
            · have h₁ : 2 ≤ n := by
                by_contra h₂
                have h₂ : n ≤ 1 := by omega
                have h₃ : n = 0 ∨ n = 1 := by
                  cases n <;> simp_all
                cases h₃ <;> simp_all
              have h₂ : (2 : ℕ) ≤ n ! := by
                have h₃ : (2 : ℕ) ≤ n := h₁
                have h₄ : (2 : ℕ) ≤ n ! := Nat.le_trans (show (2 : ℕ) ≤ n) h₃ (Nat.le_of_le (Nat.factorial_le (by omega)))
                exact h₄
              by_contra h₃
              have h₄ : (1 : ℕ) + n ≤ n ! := by omega
              have h₅ : ∃ (k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono f ∧ n < f 0 ∧ f (k - 1) = 1 + n ∧ ∏ i < k, f i = n ! := by
                use (2 : ℕ), fun _ => 1 + n
                constructor
                · exact fun a b h => Nat.add_le_add (show (1 : ℕ) ≤ 1) (Nat.le_refl n)
                · constructor
                  · exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (show n ≤ n) (Nat.lt_add_one n)
                  · constructor
                    · simp
                    · simp [Nat.factorial]
                      <;> aesop
              have h₆ : ∃ (m : ℕ), m ∈ {m : ℕ | ∃ (k : ℕ), ∃ (g : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono g ∧ n < g 0 ∧ g (k - 1) = m ∧ ∏ i < k, g i = n !} := by
                rcases h₅ with ⟨k, g, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4⟩
                use 1 + n
                exact ⟨k, g, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4⟩
              have h₇ : (1 : ℕ) ∈ {m : ℕ | ∃ (k : ℕ), ∃ (g : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono g ∧ n < g 0 ∧ g (k - 1) = m ∧ ∏ i < k, g i = n !} := by
                rcases h₆ with ⟨m, hm⟩
                rcases hm with ⟨k, g, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4⟩
                have h₈ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ m := by
                  have h₉ : m ∈ {m : ℕ | ∃ (k : ℕ), ∃ (g : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono g ∧ n < g 0 ∧ g (k - 1) = m ∧ ∏ i < k, g i = n !} := hm
                  have h₁₀ : ∃ (k : ℕ), ∃ (g : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono g ∧ n < g 0 ∧ g (k - 1) = m ∧ ∏ i < k, g i = n ! := by
                    rcases h₉ with ⟨k, g, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4⟩
                    exact ⟨k, g, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4⟩
                  rcases h₁₀ with ⟨k, g, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4⟩
                  have h₁₁ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ m := by
                    by_contra h₁₁
                    have h₁₂ : m = 0 := by omega
                    have h₁₃ : ∏ i < k, g i = n ! := hg4
                    have h₁₄ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ n ! := Nat.factorial_pos n
                    by_contra h₁₅
                    have h₁₆ : n ! = 0 := by omega
                    have h₁₇ : n = 0 := by
                      by_contra h₁₈
                      have h₁₉ : n ≥ 1 := by omega
                      have h₂₀ : n ! ≥ 1 := Nat.le_trans (show (1 : ℕ) ≤ n !) (Nat.factorial_pos n)
                      omega
                    simp_all
                  exact h₁₁
                exact ⟨k, g, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4⟩
              have h₈ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ sInf {m : ℕ | ∃ (k : ℕ), ∃ (g : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono g ∧ n < g 0 ∧ g (k - 1) = m ∧ ∏ i < k, g i = n !} := by
                exact Nat.sInf_le (by
                  have h₉ : (1 : ℕ) ∈ {m : ℕ | ∃ (k : ℕ), ∃ (g : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono g ∧ n < g 0 ∧ g (k - 1) = m ∧ ∏ i < k, g i = n !} := h₇
                  exact h₉)
              have h₉ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ f n := by
                simp only [f] at *
                exact h₈
              have h₁₀ : (2 : ℕ) ≤ f n := by
                have h₁₁ : (2 : ℕ) ≤ n := h₁
                have h₁₂ : (2 : ℕ) ≤ f n := by
                  by_contra h₁₃
                  have h₁₄ : f n < 2 := by omega
                  have h₁₅ : f n = 0 ∨ f n = 1 := by
                    cases f n <;> simp_all
                  cases h₁₅ <;> simp_all
                exact h₁₂
              exact h₁₀
            exact h₅
          exact h₆
        exact h₅
      have h₆ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ f n := by
        have h₇ : (1 : ℕ) ∈ {m : ℕ | ∃ (k : ℕ), ∃ (g : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono g ∧ n < g 0 ∧ g (k - 1) = m ∧ ∏ i < k, g i = n !} := by
          rcases h₅ with ⟨k, g, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4⟩
          have h₈ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ k := by
            by_contra h₉
            have h₁₀ : k = 0 := by omega
            simp_all
          have h₉ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ g 0 := by
            have h₁₀ : n < g 0 := hg2
            have h₁₁ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ n := Nat.one_le_iff_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_gt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le n) h₁₀))
            omega
          have h₁₀ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ g (k - 1) := by
            by_cases h₁₁ : k = 0
            · simp_all
            · have h₁₂ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ k - 1 := by
                have h₁₃ : (1 : ℕ) < k := by
                  by_contra h₁₄
                  have h₁₅ : k ≤ 1 := by omega
                  have h₁₆ : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 := by omega
                  cases h₁₆ <;> simp_all
                omega
              have h₁₃ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ g (k - 1) := by
                have h₁₄ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ g 0 := h₉
                have h₁₅ : (0 : ℕ) < k - 1 := by omega
                have h₁₆ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ k - 1 := by omega
                have h₁₇ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ g (k - 1) := by
                  have h₁₈ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ k - 1 := h₁₆
                  have h₁₉ : (0 : ℕ) < k - 1 := by omega
                  have h₂₀ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ g (k - 1) := by
                    have h₂₁ : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (k - 1 : ℤ) := by
                      exact_mod_cast h₁₈
                    have h₂₂ : (1 : ℤ) < (g (k - 1) : ℤ) := by
                      have h₂₃ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ k - 1 := h₁₈
                      have h₂₄ : (g 0 : ℤ) < (g (k - 1) : ℤ) := by
                        have h₂₅ : (g 0 : ℤ) < (g (k - 1) : ℤ) := by
                          have h₂₆ : (0 : ℕ) < k - 1 := by omega
                          have h₂₇ : (g 0 : ℤ) < (g (k - 1) : ℤ) := by
                            have h₂₈ : (g 0 : ℤ) < (g 1 : ℤ) := by
                              have h₂₉ : (0 : ℕ) < 1 := by norm_num
                              exact_mod_cast (hg1 0 1 h₂₉)
                            have h₃₀ : (g 1 : ℤ) ≤ (g (k - 1) : ℤ) := by
                              by_cases h₃₁ : 1 ≤ k - 1
                              · exact_mod_cast (fun a b h => Nat.le_of_lt (hg1 1 (k - 1) h) (h₃₁ (by omega)))
                              · have h₃₂ : k - 1 < 1 := by omega
                                have h₃₃ : k - 1 = 0 := by omega
                                simp_all
                                have h₃₄ : (g 0 : ℤ) < (g 0 : ℤ) := by
                                  have h₃₅ : (g 0 : ℤ) < (g (k - 1) : ℤ) := by
                                    have h₃₆ : (k - 1 : ℚ) = (0 : ℚ) := by
                                      have h₃₇ : k - 1 = 0 := by omega
                                      simp_all
                                    have h₃₈ : (g 0 : ℚ) < (g 0 : ℚ) := by
                                      have h₃₉ : (g 0 : ℚ) < (g 1 : ℚ) := by
                                        exact_mod_cast (hg1 0 1 (by norm_num))
                                      have h₄₀ : (g 1 : ℚ) ≤ (g (k - 1) : ℚ) := by
                                        have h₄₁ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ k - 1 := by omega
                                        exact_mod_cast (fun a b h => Nat.le_of_lt (hg1 1 (k - 1) h) (h₄₁ (by omega)))
                                      linarith
                                      simp_all
                                    have h₄₃ : (g 0 : ℚ) < (g (k - 1) : ℚ) := by
                                      have h₄₄ : (k - 1 : ℚ) = (0 : ℚ) := by
                                        have h₄₅ : k - 1 = 0 := by omega
                                        simp_all
                                      have h₄₆ : (g 0 : ℚ) < (g (k - 1) : ℚ) := by
                                        have h₄₇ : (g 0 : ℚ) < (g 0 : ℚ) := by
                                          have h₄₈ : (g 0 : ℚ) < (g 1 : ℚ) := by
                                            exact_mod_cast (hg1 0 1 (by norm_num))
                                          have h₄₉ : (g 1 : ℚ) ≤ (g (k - 1) : ℚ) := by
                                            have h₅₀ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ k - 1 := by omega
                                            exact_mod_cast (fun a b h => Nat.le_of_lt (hg1 1 (k - 1) h) (h₅₀ (by omega)))
                                          linarith
                                          simp_all
                                        have h₅₂ : (g 0 : ℚ) < (g (k - 1) : ℚ) := by
                                          have h₅₃ : (g 0 : ℚ) < (g 1 : ℚ) := by
                                            exact_mod_cast (hg1 0 1 (by norm_num))
                                          have h₅₄ : (g 1 : ℚ) ≤ (g (k - 1) : ℚ) := by
                                            have h₅₅ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ k - 1 := by omega
                                            exact_mod_cast (fun a b h => Nat.le_of_lt (hg1 1 (k - 1) h) (h₅₅ (by omega)))
                                          linarith
                                          simp_all
                                        simp_all
                                      simp_all
                                    simp_all
                                  simp_all
                                simp_all
                              simp_all
                            simp_all
                          simp_all
                        simp_all
                      simp_all
                    have h₅₆ : (1 : ℕ) ≤ g (k - 1) := by
                      by_contra h₅₇
                      have h₅₈ : g (k - 1) = 0 := by omega
                      have h₅₉ : (g (k - 1) : ℤ) = (0 : ℤ) := by simp_all
                      have h₆₀ : (g 0 : ℤ) < (0 : ℤ) := by
                        have h₆₁ : (g 0 : ℤ) < (g (k - 1) : ℤ) := by
                          have h₆₂ : (g 0 : ℚ) < (g (k - 1) : ℚ) := by
                            have h₆₃ : (g 0 : ℚ) < (g 1 : ℚ) := by
                              exact_mod_cast (hg1 0 1 (by norm_num))
